title: 身体与心情
goal: 会说哪里不舒服、现在心情怎么样，听懂别人关心你的话并回应。
tips: 身体部位 + hurt(s)：My back hurts. 也可以用 -ache：headache 头痛，toothache 牙痛，stomachache 肚子痛。
I can't wait! 是“我等不及了”，表示特别期待。

exchanges.hear: Why do you look so happy?
Are you nervous about the interview?
exchanges.replyZh: 有一点，不过我准备好了。

exchanges.reply: Yes, I need to see a dentist.

exchanges.hear: You look worried. Is everything OK?
exchanges.hearZh: 你看起来很担心，没事吧？

exchanges.hear: Are you excited about your trip?
exchanges.hearZh: 你对这次旅行很期待吧？

exchanges.reply: Because someone took his parking space.
exchanges.replyZh: 因为有人占了他的车位。

lines.en: Hey, you don't look well. What's wrong?
lines.zh: 嘿，你脸色不太好。怎么了？

lines.en: I have a headache, and my throat hurts.
Oh no. Do you have a fever?
I don't think so. I'm just tired.
You should go home and rest.
You're right. I'm also a bit worried about my exam tomorrow.
lines.zh: 你说得对。我还有点担心明天的考试。

lines.en: Don't worry. You studied hard. You'll be fine.
lines.zh: 别担心，你那么用功，没问题的。

lines.en: Thanks. That makes me feel better.
lines.zh: 谢谢，听你这么说我好受多了。
